applicabilityBasis.summary: GHSm targets the Ghanaian cedi and is marketed for local payments, remittances and microlending. MGP-18 identifies its legacy reserve-backed USDm/GHSm Broker pool and describes exits into USDm, a digital asset, rather than an issuer payment of national currency or a bank deposit. The reviewed materials do not establish a person obligated to redeem holders for a fixed amount of monetary value under GENIUS section 2(22). Payment-related use and the documented USDm exit therefore leave scope genuinely ambiguous rather than establish either a conclusive exclusion or an apparent qualifying payment stablecoin.

genius.notes: Reviewed 2026-10-28. Mento Protocol is a protocol-family descriptor, not an identified legal issuer or a statutory redemption obligor. Mento Labs GmbH is described as a technical and operations provider; foundation stewardship and governance roles do not establish that any particular entity owes GHSm holders a fixed-fiat payment. MGP-18 and the explicit token configuration support legacy shared-reserve backing for GHSm; the general V3 CDP description must not be substituted for its exact pool. Public protocol exits into USDm are documented. redemptionPolicyPresent is false for an identified issuer's fixed-fiat redemption policy, not a claim that protocol exit documentation is absent. The reserve dashboard is self-published disclosure, not evidence of GENIUS-compliant collateral or independent assurance. No independent monthly attestation series was located in the reviewed materials. No qualifying public authorization, filed application, registered foreign exception or token-specific announced GENIUS route was located in the bounded source review. Legal issuer, domicile, foreign pathway, enforcement and DASP posture remain unresolved. MGP-19 and CGP-253 are proposals and are not treated as evidence of completed control transfers. High confidence attaches to the documented scope ambiguity and dated negative search, not a legal conclusion that GENIUS applies or does not apply. The official deployment table identifies the tracked Celo contract 0xfaea5f3404bba20d3cc2f8c4b0a888f55a3c7313 as the corresponding StableToken. This confirms token identity, not a legal issuer or redemption obligation.

This is a bounded public-source finding; the legal issuer remains unresolved and confidential filings, unindexed notices and all other state registers were not exhaustively reviewed.
